newsitem.title: USA: Applied Intelligence begins catalog service.
newsitem.headline: Applied Intelligence begins catalog service.

text.p: Applied Intelligence Group Inc said Monday it began offering an electronic catalog serice to two convenience store chains.

The company said its viaLink Item Catalog Service provides secure communication over the Internet between convenience store headquarters and manufacturers, wholesalers and direct store delivery suppliers. The first customers using the service are Fleming Cos Inc and Nice N Easy Grocery Shoppes Inc, the company said.
Applied Intelligence develops computer systems for retailers. Its stock was up 5/16 in late morning trade at 4-17/16.
